tools.name: search_person
tools.description: Perform an OSINT search for a person to find their profile, current residence, aliases, relatives, and online footprint using Gemini Search Grounding.

full_name.description: The full name of the person to search

city_state.description: Optional city, state or location context, e.g. Austin, TX

tools.name: reverse_phone
tools.description: Perform a reverse phone lookup to find carrier information, phone line type, risk score, and associated names.

phone.description: The phone number in national or E.164 format

tools.name: username_scan
tools.description: Check if a username exists across 8 major platforms (GitHub, Reddit, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Telegram, HackerNews, Keybase) in real-time.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Get real-time details of an IP address including country, region, city, ISP, and threat score.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Query live DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS) for a given domain.

domain.description: The domain name to query, e.g. google.com

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve WHOIS domain registration details using real-time search grounding.

domain.description: The domain name to look up

tools.name: search_people_directories
tools.description: Query open public people search engines and public record directories (TruePeopleSearch, Whitepages, FastPeopleSearch, That'sThem, Spokeo, Radaris) using Search Grounding.

full_name.description: Legal full name of the subject

city_state.description: City and State or County jurisdiction (e.g. Austin, TX)

age_or_dob.description: Optional approximate age or birth year

tools.name: cross_reference_breaches
tools.description: Cross-reference single identities or bulk/batch CSV lists of usernames, emails, phones, and subject names against known public breach database telemetry to calculate Evidentiary Credibility Scores (0-100%) and verify skip-trace authenticity.

subject_name.description: Subject legal or full name (for single mode)

targets_csv.description: Multi-line CSV or comma-separated list of targets (e.g. 'Marcus Vance, marcus.vance, mvance@techcorp.com\nSarah Jenkins, sarah.jenkins88, sarah@austinenergy.org') for bulk batch verification

batch_mode.description: Set to true to execute bulk multi-target verification
